notes.title: Update 0.3810
notes.notes:
[h1]Frost and magic[/h1]

Greetings fellow Supa's updated build is finally published.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[*]moved health and mana bars to controllers, maybe before was better

[b]Sound:[/b]
[*] make it react to environment, now it does in some way but most of the time opposite than what is desired  
[*] there are some issues with number of sounds playing

[b] Magic: [/b]    
None of magic have proper names yet, still open to suggestions.Don't forget you can chain magic together and mixing them with projectiles, can be quite fun.

[b] Physics: [/b]  
[*] occasional crash, have no idea why yet

[b]Weapon changes:[/b]  
[*] slight modifications to damage parameters 
[*] finally managed to find bug for explosive arrow and fire spitter, they finally work as expected.

[b]Levels:[/b]   
[*] added spikes at entrances

[b] Options: [/b] 
[*] no new options

[b]Monsters:[/b]   
[*] some monsters will no longer stop when hit and will consequentially move faster towards you if you do not knock them out 
[*] a bit more stupider than yesterday
[*] added new dying animations that transition from grounded state

[b]Known issues[/b]  
[*] teleportation in new levels can still accidentally put player inside walls, you need to literally walk out of wall, or restart mission, working on this, changes will come as geometry for levels will be finished 
[*] when touching an item in backpack it can explode


Try new magic and let me know us know about changes

Best,
T

notes.title: Update announcement 0.3743
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow Supa's of November 7th 2016. We are happy to announce new update:
[h1]"Trigger Happy Fuse Forever"[/h1] 

coming to storage near you soon, real soon, ASAP, eh ... well maybe tomorrow.
 
 This update is a bit more optimized, reduced download size, reduced textures, bit more compressed sounds, few performance improvements.
  
 [b] Changes: [/b]
 [*] loading level changes, now transforms temple to front of current labyrinth
 [*] you can now start bomb with bullets, magic and other flaming items
  
 [b] Options: [/b] 
 [*] no new options
  
 [b] Sound: [/b]    
 [*] make it react to environment, now it does in some way but most of the time opposite than what is desired  
 
 [b] Magic: [/b]    
 [*] added "fire shield" - makes a ring of fire
 [*] added "lightning shield"  - lightning spirals around
 [*] added "bouncer shield" - seven fireballs burst 
 [*] added "frost vertigo something" 
 [b]None of these have proper names yet, open to suggestions[/b]
  
 Don't forget you can chain attacks together. Also mixing magic with projectiles can be quite fun.
  
 [b]Weapon changes:[/b]  
 [*] slight modifications to damage parameters 
  
 [b]Levels:[/b]   
 [*] all 8 levels (removed Pluto) are playable
  
 [b]Monsters:[/b]   
 [*] they never were smart, but right now I think they are even more stupider than ever. 
  
 [b]Known issues[/b]  
 [*] teleporting in new levels can still accidentaly put player inside walls, you need to literally walk out of wall, or restart mission, working on this, changes will come as geometry for levels will be finished 
 [*] when touching an item in backpack can explode 

check video for few magic combos, action starts 6min-ish 
https://youtu.be/Exte6McY-0s?t=5m24s

Untill build gets online

Enjoy and stay healthy, 

T

notes.title: Update 0.3027
notes.notes:
Greetings fellow Supa's we are happy to announce new features, bug fixes and introduce you to new undefined behaviours that are crawling inside code. 
 
 [b]New functionality:[/b]
 [*]  you can now headbutt monsters 
 [*]  Added crate, primary use is for smaller player to step on it, so they can reach putting eyes into supreme being, also reach higher places and all kinds of other strange stuff, like build a tower or teleport into air 
 
 [b]Sound:[/b]
 [*]  Added 20 additional sounds for impacts and explosions 
 [*]  monsters scream when on fire, acid, electricity or poison, (can be quite loud and annoying)
 [*]  there are still plenty of gaps and missing sounds, working on it
 
 [b]Weapons changes & new weapons:[/b]
 [*]  Bouncer bolt now affects touched muscle
 [*]  Explosive arrow 
 [*]  Added small bomb, affects muscles and knocks them out for short time, can affect time
 [*]  Added tiny bomb, affects muscles but does not knock them out directly, sometimes explodes with 10x power

 [b]New weapon/damage type:[/b]
 [*] Limb Number aka Limb Numb®, numbs creature limbs, rather bizarre, can make creatures walk in strange ways, (has some performance issues though, so it was at last moment disabled) 
 
   
 [b]New animations on creatures:[/b] 
 [*]  can fake injury 
 [*]  try to do something scary 
 [*]  do kung-fu
 [*]  try to hide in plain sight 
 [*]  do other monkey business
  
 [b]Movement:[/b] 
 [*]  adjusted walk and sprint speed for teleport (run with both touch pads pressed)
 [*]  added option to use left controller as joystick to move (makes me instant sick, so if someone is willing to test it and tell me if it works for them)
   
 [b]Environment:[b]
 [*]  changed starting scene to a "Temple of eternal stone and pillars of youth", this is temporary, since it needs to be a heptagram, we messed it up and everybody wants heptagram
 [*]  moved supreme monster creation from centre of labyrinth into temple
 [*]  changed how levels work, once you reach the centre you will be automatically transported back to temple, could do that player has to walk back, but it is really hard to go in&out especially in complex labyrinths
 [*]  scene loading interface proxy, (latest news: there are some issues if loading levels quickly)
 [*]  started preparing levels, 9 proxy geometry for labyrinths are done, 4 levels are playable, rest are for preview (try to reach the centre of hard levels, if you can)
 [*]  new levels have issues of walking through walls, this will be resolved once final geometry is ready
   
 [b]Graphics:[b] 
 [*]  added anti aliasing option (doesn't do much to be honest, will ramp it up in next iteration) 
 [*]  added back bloom effect, as it is now working in Single-Pass stereo 
   
 [b]Interface:[b]
 [*]  placed menus on controller, easier to use and to see whats written
 [*]  added "continue" to main menu if game in progress
 [*]  found one panel that was blocking ray casts (one still exists somewhere)
    
 [b]Other fixes:[b]
 [*]  shield is visible and working as expected (activate with lower touch pad on controller) 
   
 [b]Cheats:[b]
 [*]  added option to reveal most of weapons
 [*]  added option to start with with endless stream of creatures resulting in total mayhem (you don't want this)
  
 [b]Easter eggs:[b] 
 [*]  added new hidden area
 [*]  left option to go into air and experience view from above 
 [*]  last part of supreme being creation is still disabled :)
   
 [b]Known issues [/b]
 [*]  automatic weapons shoot two bullets at start, so player knows it is an automatic type. but we don't know if it is a feature or a bug
 [*]  we know you can walk through walls, this bug came in as we changed how levels are loaded and will be fixed soon 
 [*]  other, too many to list them here 

Hope you'll like these new additions, till next time, take care and enjoy.
